title: The profiled residual Ritz descent is uniformly of order N to the five-halves

ritz_scaling.covariance_counting: For fixed g>0, K1572 gives kappa_(g,N)^+/N^2->kappa_g>0 and h_N^2=Theta_g(N^2). The covariance coefficients a_(N,k)=[2 sqrt(omega_k^2+kappa_(g,N)^+)]^(-1) are Theta_g(N^(-1)) on a fixed positive fraction of cutoff modes and O_g(N^(-1)) uniformly.
ritz_scaling.convolution_scales: Positive Fourier convolution counting gives int Gamma_N^3=Theta_g(N^3) and int Gamma_N^4=Theta_g(N^5): there are Theta(N^6) admissible triples and Theta(N^9) admissible quadruples in fixed interior mode boxes, with matching full-box upper counts.
ritz_scaling.residual_scale: K1586 therefore yields sigma_N^2=Theta_g(N^5) and sigma_N=Theta_g(N^(5/2)).
ritz_scaling.second_diagonal: For u_N=R_NG_N/sigma_N and delta_N=<u_N,(H_N-lambda_N)u_N>, the Gaussian ground-state transform bounds the degree-at-most-four Dirichlet part by O_g(N). Finite-chaos hypercontractivity gives |E(R_N^3)|/sigma_N^2<=C sigma_N. Hence |delta_N|=O_g(N^(5/2)).
ritz_scaling.ritz_gap: The exact two-dimensional gap is Delta_N=[sqrt(delta_N^2+4 sigma_N^2)-delta_N]/2. Since sigma_N=Theta_g(N^(5/2)) and |delta_N|<=C_g sigma_N, Delta_N=Theta_g(N^(5/2)).
ritz_scaling.coefficient_ceiling: The Ritz improvement diverges but is o(N^4). It proves a quantitative subleading descent from the profiled Gaussian and does not decide whether the unrestricted N^4 coefficient equals or lies below h_g^prof.
ritz_scaling.scope_guard: Constants may depend on fixed positive g, mass, torus and cutoff convention. No unrestricted matching lower bound, exact subleading coefficient, localization, compactness or Mosco recovery is proved.
